name: HOZO AM 2.0 personal LINE identity routing
requiresDatabases: HOZO AM 2.0 group bindings with exact member user IDs

dataIsolation.guard: A private LINE event routes only when its stable user ID occurs in formally enabled group member maps of exactly one tenant that explicitly enables personal-assistant. Direct events never enter group onMessage hooks.

definitionOfDone: A unique active HOZO AM 2.0 member user ID resolves to the HOZO AM 2.0 tenant
Shadow, disabled, unknown, ambiguous and lookup-failure identities fail closed
Direct LINE events invoke only onDirectMessage handlers
Group events retain the existing group routing path
A bound direct message receives an identity-confirmation reply
No private identity data or messages are committed to AMCore
